criteria.criterion: Nelson location rules and CUSUM can identify a sustained residual location shift without any point-threshold crossing.
CUSUM reports the first detection position, direction, accumulated score, and configured threshold.
Trend, oscillation, and mixture findings retain their specific pattern meanings.
Moving-range findings identify variation changes separately from location changes.

capabilities.manual_review: Inspected location_shift_up: zero point episodes and distinct overlapping Nelson/CUSUM/oscillation findings, with rule-specific detection positions.

criteria.criterion: A sufficiently extreme calibrated sample records a point trigger and the expectation it departed from.
Repeated runs of the same fixed request preserve numerical evidence; future samples do not change earlier scoring for declared settings.
Adjacent point departures form a consecutive-run pattern with the contributing sample positions.
Separated point departures remain separate episodes, and positional episode intervals use integer coordinates.

capabilities.manual_review: Inspected spike: one episode at sample 65, original observed value retained, and overlapping CUSUM/moving-range findings interpreted separately.

criteria.criterion: Repeating seasonal structure with stable calibration can yield supported readiness.
Unstable declared seasonality or a drifting calibration center yields caution without making an otherwise completed run fail.
Insufficient calibration support yields not_assessed, including when the run otherwise completes.
Later evaluation changes do not rewrite the segment's training-and-calibration readiness assessment.

capabilities.manual_review: Inspected spike readiness caution for residual autocorrelation and conversion not_assessed for three calibration samples; neither absence of findings nor a large score establishes alert accuracy.

criteria.criterion: Short series return reference evidence and an insufficient_history status instead of inventing calibrated findings.
Provisional residual scores can be reported but do not trigger point-anomaly episodes.
Completed calibration provides a frozen residual center and sample scale for later standardized residuals.
Evidence records the observed value, expectation, calibration support, and numerical criterion responsible for a trigger.

capabilities.manual_review: Inspected spike sample 65: calibrated, 14 calibration samples, observed 135.2, expected 94.875, standardized residual 85.3088, and a point trigger; score semantics explicitly exclude probability.

criteria.criterion: Each rolling expectation uses only observations before the sample being scored.
Persistent growth changes can be followed more closely than by the frozen default recipe.
An isolated extreme value is held out of future model references rather than creating a seasonal echo.
Conflicting trend choices and slope lookbacks exceeding the adaptive window are rejected.

capabilities.manual_review: Inspected rolling window, bounded slope lookback, causal projection and model parameters, plus frozen residual calibration; reviewed persistence admission and isolated-extreme tests.

criteria.criterion: A supplied season length selects earlier matching seasonal observations for the reference.
Automatic trend selection represents suitable linear and compound growth without flagging ordinary growth as point anomalies.
The fitted trend remains frozen after training within a regime; later changed values do not rewrite that fit.
Callers can explicitly select none, linear, or exponential trend, and unsupported trend modes are rejected.

capabilities.manual_review: Inspected growth_up and compound: linear/exponential selections respectively, zero point episodes and zero patterns.

criteria.criterion: Robust seasonal references reduce the influence of an extreme prior matching seasonal value.
Training and calibration diagnostics identify excluded extreme observations.
An extreme evaluated sample remains evidence while its expected value is used in future references.
Callers can choose include mode to retain raw extreme observations and inspect the resulting echo behavior.

capabilities.manual_review: Inspected spike sample: observed 135.2 remains visible while model_value 94.875 and reference_action use_expected protect future references; reviewed training/calibration exclusions.

criteria.criterion: Integer positions and exact observed dates or timestamps can identify reset boundaries.
Each new regime rebuilds its reference, trend, and calibration without crossing earlier boundaries.
Repeated, out-of-range, or unmatched reset points are rejected.
CLI reset options produce the same resolved positions and suppress departures explained by the declared boundaries.

capabilities.manual_review: Inspected steps_reset: resolved boundaries 50 and 100, completed analysis, no episodes or patterns.

criteria.criterion: An explicit season length is honored and reported as explicit.
A repeating positional series can infer a seasonal lag and report the selection window.
A positional series without a sufficiently stable candidate falls back to lag one and records why.
The reserved calibration and evaluation tail does not determine positional season selection.

capabilities.manual_review: Inspected positional-season: lag 7, selection window [0,27], ranked candidates, strength criteria, and separate confirmation candidates; domain confirmation remains a stated interpretation limit.

criteria.criterion: Callers can select sum, mean, or last aggregation for completed and partial periods.
Regular timestamped sub-day samples produce distinct native and completed-period analysis views.
A trailing partial aggregate reports observed progress and links its native evidence while remaining outside the completed-period series.
An explicitly unfinished source sample is excluded from both analysis views.
A source cadence that does not evenly divide 24 hours is rejected.

capabilities.manual_review: Inspected multi-resolution: separate completed_period/intraday namespaces; trailing 12/24 finalized samples aggregate to 1200 and link 12 intraday evidence records, excluded from completed-period scoring.

criteria.criterion: Ordered value lists work with separate settings, while schema 1.0 requests describe one dataset.
Schema 1.1 datasets declare a nonempty entity scope and support explicit relationships between named datasets.
Unknown settings, unsupported recipes, nonfinite values, booleans, and numeric strings are rejected.
Published schema 1.0 and 1.1 request and result schemas match the public Python contracts.

capabilities.manual_review: Read README input/API examples and schema-version limits; independently parsed all four published schemas and asserted equality to their current public contracts.

criteria.criterion: Incomplete observations form a trailing suffix after chronological preparation.
The observed values and timestamps of unfinished periods remain available in data quality output.
Incomplete source samples are excluded from expectations, calibration, point scoring, and completed aggregates.
A relationship with an unavailable latest source reports that unavailability rather than normal behavior.

capabilities.manual_review: Inspected incomplete-usage MCP drilldown: partial run and latest relationship evidence unavailable, with explicit unavailable lineage instead of a normality claim.

criteria.criterion: Timestamped datasets provide both timestamps and frequency; positional datasets provide neither.
Local timestamps require a timezone, and ambiguous or nonexistent daylight-saving times require an explicit offset.
Duplicate timestamps are rejected unless an aggregation policy is supplied; duplicate counts and transformations remain visible.
An as_of cutoff excludes later observations, and cadence is checked as a fixed elapsed duration.

capabilities.manual_review: Inspected UTC normalization, sorted/duplicate/cutoff transformations and resolved API context; cross-interface context tests establish a 71-observation cutoff.

criteria.criterion: A method failure preserves evidence completed before the failure and reports the error.
Runtime budgets are checked cooperatively and produce an explicit stop reason.
CLI byte limits and execution failures produce distinct error exits.
A failed dataset or relationship leaves healthy sibling results available and marks the overall run partial.

capabilities.manual_review: Inspected failure/budget and sibling-failure tests and error handlers: retained evidence through index 44, explicit runtime_budget, and healthy sibling results; budget checks are cooperative.

criteria.criterion: The methods command lists supported analysis recipes and residual detectors.
Equivalent file and stdin JSON inputs produce equivalent request fingerprints and analysis semantics.
CSV supports positional or timestamped selected values, treats empty cells as missing, and rejects varying unmapped entity columns.
Settings resolve in embedded-request, settings-file, then CLI-flag precedence; bare JSON values can use CLI configuration.
Output files require explicit overwrite permission, and invalid input is distinguished from execution failure by exit status.

capabilities.manual_review: Executed conversion and unit-cost readable CLI plus spike JSON CLI; inspected stdout results, empty stderr on successful runs, and explicit partial exit 1 for incomplete-usage.

criteria.criterion: Point-anomaly episode counts and residual-pattern findings are labeled separately.
Relationship cases identify entity scope, observed and expected values, declared units, and investigation questions.
Explicit numerical rules are named with their boundaries instead of appearing as statistical anomaly claims.
Readiness status remains visible, including when it was not assessed.

capabilities.manual_review: Read conversion and unit-cost stdout: entity/unit labels, observed versus expected conversion, named 0.13 unit-cost boundary, investigation questions and not_assessed readiness remain clear.

criteria.criterion: Tool discovery advertises analyze, list_findings, and get_evidence as read-only with input and output schemas.
Legacy initialization and modern stateless discovery return supported protocol metadata and interpretation guidance.
Analysis tool calls return structured content together with compact text.
Invalid tool input and unknown session run IDs return structured errors rather than fabricated results.

capabilities.manual_review: Read protocol discovery instructions and pyproject console entrypoint; full-suite stdio test starts the server in the installed Python environment and verifies handshake/tool listing.

criteria.criterion: The analyze tool returns a compact headline, finding preview, and run ID for subsequent evidence requests.
list_findings pages through cases, candidates, episodes, patterns, and data-quality findings.
get_evidence exposes the selected finding's numerical support and relationship source lineage.
Unavailable latest evidence and non-triggering early candidates remain visible, while large pattern sample sets are paginated.

capabilities.manual_review: Followed analyze, list_findings and get_evidence for conversion: observed 8/130 versus expected 0.1, source indexes 14/14 and not_assessed readiness support the compact headline.

criteria.criterion: analyze accepts bare ordered values with separate validated settings and dispatches canonical schema 1.0 or 1.1 requests.
analyze_series preserves supplied settings and event-time context for a single dataset.
analyze_relationships preserves the declared multi-dataset relationship semantics.
Equivalent requests retain numerical results across Python, CLI, and full-result MCP compatibility calls apart from run IDs and runtime.

capabilities.manual_review: Read README Python facade examples, model_dump_json usage and settings/context semantics; inspected parity tests across Python, CLI and full-result MCP calls.

criteria.criterion: The first observation records a value, the second records a change, and later departures from the prior range can be candidates.
Descriptive assessments use preceding observations and remain unchanged when future samples are appended.
Missing values break the comparison history, and zero previous values do not create relative-change evidence.
Early candidates remain non-triggering and ineligible for action even under a permissive policy.

capabilities.manual_review: Read candidate comparison population, early maturity, established/not_established text and MCP candidate tests; candidates have criterion_met false and never authorize action.

criteria.criterion: Evidence for different declared entities remains in separate cases even at the same event time.
Criteria met in multiple source datasets can raise numerical severity and identify the contributing sources.
A derived relationship adds context without counting as an additional independent source for severity.
Adaptive location-shift rules can create an early grouped case without a point trigger, using only evidence available at detection.

capabilities.manual_review: Inspected conversion case contributors, explanation, evidence references and investigation questions; correlated source/derived support is grouped without adding a source vote.

criteria.criterion: Default policy leaves action and notification eligibility disabled.
Explicit-rule and calibrated-departure eligibility are controlled independently.
Notification eligibility can be allowed for a met criterion without action eligibility, while early candidates remain ineligible.
Replaying policy preserves numerical evidence and stable case IDs, records changed case revisions, and leaves the original result unchanged.

capabilities.manual_review: Compared unit-cost default versus allow_explicit_rules policy: action eligibility false/true, with identical relationship lineage and numerical violation.

criteria.criterion: Values outside an inclusive acceptable range are violations, while values on the boundary are accepted.
Absolute and relative changes must exceed their declared maximum to violate a rule.
Relative-change checks require a nonzero previous value and do not bridge missing observations.
Violations identify the exact declared rule and remain action-ineligible unless policy explicitly permits them.

capabilities.manual_review: Read unit-cost stdout and drilldown: review-above-13c outside [0,0.13] is a caller-declared numerical criterion, with explicit non-claims about cause and incidents.

criteria.criterion: Ratios retain the computed value, formula, and original source indexes for each sample.
Differences, supplied-scale residuals, and all/any threshold conditions produce the declared derived values.
Missing sources and zero denominators remain unavailable with a reason rather than becoming zero.
Derived series can be analyzed with the frozen or adaptive single-resolution recipe.

capabilities.manual_review: Inspected conversion drilldown: relationship departure 8/130 versus expected 0.1 while source datasets have no point episodes; lineage preserves formula and source positions.

criteria.criterion: A supplied lag and coefficient use the predictor at the declared earlier sample position.
Derived values retain response and predictor source indexes and source cutoffs in lineage.
When requested, the coefficient is fitted once from a declared training prefix and remains frozen.
Samples lacking the earlier predictor or awaiting coefficient training remain unavailable.

capabilities.manual_review: Inspected lagged-response leading unavailable values and first usable sample: supplied coefficient 2, lag 2, response index 2/predictor index 0 and source cutoff preserved.

criteria.criterion: Related datasets use identical normalized timestamps, the same declared cadence, and matching entity metadata.
Relationship sources are timestamped and have unique timestamps; implicit resampling and duplicate aggregation are not accepted for lineage.
Difference relationships require identical declared source units and matching output units.
An invalid relationship is reported as failed while valid sibling dataset results remain available.

capabilities.manual_review: Read target errors/statuses and exact-alignment tests: timestamp/cadence/entity/unit mismatch or failed source yields a failed relationship while a healthy sibling remains available.
